title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) has practice window opened
items.desc: The Commanders opened the practice window for Jacory Croskey-Merritt.
items.impact: Croskey-Merritt has been on injured reserve with a groin injury. He'll have 21 days to be activated.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Riley Patterson perfect in loss Monday
items.desc: Riley Patterson made both of his field-goal attempts and both of his extra-point attempts in Monday night's 23-20 loss to the Los Angeles Chargers.
items.impact: Patterson did well in his debut with the Ravens on Monday night. He made all four of his attempted kicks over the course of the game, which left him responsible for eight of the team's 20 total points. He will likely retain the starting job for the foreseeable future with Tyler Loop (groin) currently on injured reserve.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dayo Odeyingbo (quad) not expected to return to practice this week
items.desc: Bears head coach Ben Johnson said he doesn't see DE Dayo Odeyingbo coming off IR this week.
items.impact: Johnson was eligible to return this week  with a quad injury after being put on injured reserve on October 17.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: David Montgomery (groin) practices Tuesday
items.desc: David Montgomery practiced on Tuesday.
items.impact: Montgomery is trending towards having a chance to return for Thursday's game against the Colts.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Danielle Hunter (hamstring) not expected to play in Week 11
items.desc: Danielle Hunter is not expected to play on Thursday against the Colts.
items.impact: Hunter remained sidelined from practice on Tuesday. He won't be ready to return on a short week for the Texans.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) not expected to play in Week 11
items.desc: Marvin Harrison Jr. is not expected to play on Thursday against the Colts.
items.impact: Harrison remained sidelined from practice on Tuesday. He won't be ready to return on a short week for the Texans.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kyler Gordon (shoulder) considered day-to-day
items.desc: Bears CB Kyler Gordon is day-to-day with a shoulder injury.
items.impact: Gordon did not practice on Monday. He will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Luther Burden III clears concussion protocol
items.desc: Bears head coach Ben Johnson said Luther Burden is out of concussion protocol.
items.impact: Burden suffered the injury two weeks ago before the Bears bye week. He'll be good to go for Sunday's game against the Saints.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Keylan Rutledge (stinger) practicing Tuesday
items.desc: Keylan Rutledge returned to practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Rutledge had been sidelined with a neck and shoulder stinger. He will have a chance to return for Thursday's game against the Colts.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Azeez Al-Shaair (groin) to undergo surgery
items.desc: Texans LB Azeez Al-Shaair is dealing with a groin injury that will require surgery.
items.impact: It explains why Al-Shaair was placed on injured reserve on Tuesday. There should be a more clear timetable for his return following his surgery.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Haggai Ndubuisi signs with Packers
items.desc: The Packers signed DT Haggai Ndubuisi.
items.impact: Ndubuisi lands an opportunity following a successful workout.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Woody Marks (concussion) ruled out for Week 11
items.desc: Woody Marks has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Colts.
items.impact: Marks left this past week's game with a concussion. He will be sidelined on a short week for the Texans.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Sabastian Harsh signs with Texans
items.desc: The Texans signed Sabastian Harsh to their practice squad.
items.impact: Houston released Junior Tafuna as the corresponding move.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Junior Tafuna released by Texans
items.desc: The Texans released Junior Tafuna.
items.impact: Tafuna will seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: D.J. Reed Jr. (hip) uncertain for Week 11
items.desc: Dan Campbell said he didn't know if D.J. Reed will return in Week 11 against the Bucs.
items.impact: Reed has not practiced since injuring his hip in Week 8.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Roman Wilson (finger) hopeful to return in Week 11
items.desc: Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy said he's "hopeful" Roman Wilson can return in Week 11.
items.impact: Wilson has missed the past month for Pittsburgh as has Michael Pittman Jr. They will both have a chance to return this week. They'll need to be monitored in practice.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) hopeful to return in Week 11
items.desc: Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy said he's "hopeful" Michael Pittman Jr. can return in Week 11.
items.impact: Pittman has missed the past month for Pittsburgh as has Roman Wilson. They will both have a chance to return this week. They'll need to be monitored in practice.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Kerby Joseph (knee) likely to return in Week 11
items.desc: Kerby Joseph (knee) is likely to make his season debut on Sunday against the Buccaneers.
items.impact: Joseph last played over 13 months ago because of a significant knee injury, but the All-Pro safety is reportedly on the cusp of making his long-awaited return for the Lions. Joseph picked off three passes over six games last season after coming up with a whopping nine interceptions in 2024.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ravens D/ST struggles in loss Monday
items.desc: The Ravens' D/ST logged two sacks and allowed 23 points in Monday night's loss to the Los Angeles Chargers.
items.impact: Baltimore's defense had a bad game on Monday night. They weren't able to log any turnovers over the course of the game and ended up allowing 23 points, which was enough to send Los Angeles home with the win. This unit should not be started outside of the most favorable matchups moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Josh Cuevas racks up 37 yards Monday
items.desc: Josh Cuevas caught three passes for 37 yards in Monday night's 23-20 loss to the Los Angeles Chargers.
items.impact: Cuevas was a solid contributor on Monday night, finishing with 37 yards on three catches en route to a narrow loss to the Chargers. Fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to be fantasy relevant moving forward, even if he continues to be a decent enough contributor in real life.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ja'Kobi Lane solid in loss Monday
items.desc: Ja'Kobi Lane caught 3-of-11 targets for 61 yards in Monday night's 23-20 loss to the Los Angeles Chargers.
items.impact: The rookie saw the most targets out of anybody on the team on Monday night. He was only able to bring in three of them, however, but he was still able to finish with a solid 61 yards over the course of the game. He will have fantasy value if he continues to be targeted at this rate moving forward, but that's far from a guarantee.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Mark Andrews leads team in receiving Monday
items.desc: Mark Andrews caught eight passes for 82 yards in Monday night's 23-20 loss to the Los Angeles Chargers.
items.impact: Andrews had a good game on Monday night. He led the team in receptions and receiving yards in this loss to the Chargers, although he wasn't able to get into the end zone at all to cap it off. We saw QB Jacoby Brissett hyper-target the TE position when he was in Arizona earlier in the year, so Andrews could be a worthwhile streaming option if that trend now continues in Baltimore, as it did on Monday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Rashod Bateman catches three passes in loss Monday
items.desc: Rashod Bateman caught 3-of-5 targets for 42 yards in Monday night's 23-20 loss to the Los Angeles Chargers.
items.impact: Bateman was able to contribute three catches for 42 yards on Monday night, but that wasn't enough to propel the Ravens to a win over Los Angeles. QB Jacoby Brissett's passing attempts will fall over the next few weeks as well, so fantasy managers shouldn't expect Bateman to be valuable at any point in the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Justice Hill active as receiver in win Monday
items.desc: Justice Hill rushed the ball three times for four yards and hauled in 5-of-7 targets for 34 yards in Monday night's 23-20 loss to the Los Angeles Chargers.
items.impact: Hill was a non-factor in the rushing game on Monday night, but he was able to get involved as a pass catcher, finishing with five catches for 34 yards. Those are high-value touches, but fantasy managers still shouldn't expect him to be a reliable fantasy asset for the foreseeable future given his lack of consistent work in the rushing game.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Zay Flowers racks up 74 yards in loss Monday
items.desc: Zay Flowers hauled in 6-of-7 targets for 74 yards in Monday night's 23-20 loss to the Los Angeles Chargers.
items.impact: Flowers was able to put up a respectable performance on Monday night. He finished with six catches for 74 yards, which left him with a decent fantasy total in PPR formats. His game-to-game outlook may be rocky moving forward, however, as fantasy managers can't expect QB Jacoby Brissett to continue to attempt 49 passes per game over the back half of the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Derrick Henry scores twice in loss Monday
items.desc: Derrick Henry rushed the ball ten times for ten yards and two touchdowns and caught five passes for ten yards in Monday night's 23-20 loss to the Los Angeles Chargers.
items.impact: Henry was incredibly inefficient on Monday night, racking up just 20 yards on 15 total touches. He was able to get two goal-line touchdowns over the course of the game, which left him with a good fantasy total when paired with his five receptions. He should continue to get all of the work in this backfield moving forward, but his efficiency and Baltimore's offensive struggles will call into question his game-to-game consistency.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jacoby Brissett scoreless in Ravens debut Moday
items.desc: Jacoby Brissett completed 33-of-49 passing attempts for 340 yards and one interception in Monday night's 23-20 loss to the Los Angeles Chargers.
items.impact: Brissett threw the ball nearly 50 times in his first game with the Ravens. He was able to rack up 340 yards in the process, but he didn't score any touchdowns, which left him with an underwhelming fantasy score individually. He was able to successfully support Zay Flowers and Mark Andrews, but the team will almost certainly want him to throw significantly less passes on a game-to-game basis moving forward, so those guys may not have the consistent workload that this week suggested they might.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chargers D/ST logs two turnovers in win Monday
items.desc: The Chargers' D/ST logged two sacks, one interception, and one fumble recovery while allowing 20 points in Monday night's win over the Baltimore Ravens.
items.impact: Los Angeles' defense played pretty well on Monday night. They allowed just 20 points over the course of the night and were able to log a few big plays, including a key forced fumble that helped secure the win for them late in the game. This unit will have favorable matchups against the Jets and Patriots coming up over the next couple of weeks.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Cameron Dicker scores 11 points in win Monday
items.desc: Cameron Dicker went 3-for-3 on his field-goal attempts and 2-for-2 on his extra-point attempts in Monday night's 23-20 win over the Baltimore Ravens.
items.impact: Dicker played well on Monday night. He made all five of his kicks over the course of the game, and his accuracy was very much needed in this narrow win over the Ravens. He will be a decent fantasy option moving forward if Los Angeles' offense can continue to move the ball competently.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Charlie Kolar catches two passes in win Monday
items.desc: Charlie Kolar caught 2-of-3 targets for 16 yards in Monday night's 23-20 win over the Baltimore Ravens.
items.impact: Kolar was Los Angeles' second-leading receiver in their win over his former team on Monday night. That didn't amount to much, however, and fantasy managers shouldn't have high expectations for him over the back half of the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Oronde Gadsden II held to one catch in win Monday
items.desc: Oronde Gadsden II caught just one pass for seven yards in Monday night's 23-20 win over the Baltimore Ravens.
items.impact: The Chargers were able to pick up their first win of the season on Monday night. Gadsen didn't get very involved in that, however, finishing with just one catch for a measly seven yards on the night. He won't be fantasy relevant moving forward, even if Los Angeles is able to parlay this into a streak of wins.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tre' Harris leads team in receiving Monday
items.desc: Tre' Harris caught five passes for 86 yards in Sunday's 23-20 win over the Baltimore Ravens.
items.impact: Harris was by far Los Angeles' leading receiver on Monday night. He finished with 86 yards over the course of the night, which was 70 more than the second-leading receiver on the team. He will see less opportunities whenever Ladd McConkey (back) makes his return to the lineup, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Keaton Mitchell silent in win Monday
items.desc: Keaton Mitchell rushed the ball three times for four yards in Monday night's 23-20 win over the Baltimore Ravens.
items.impact: Mitchell didn't see much work on Monday night, carrying the ball just a few times in the team's narrow win over the Ravens. It looks like Omarion Hampton is going to be their bellcow moving forward, which means that Mitchell will be off of the fantasy radar entirely at this point in the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kimani Vidal uninvolved in win Monday
items.desc: Kimani Vidal rushed the ball two times for zero yards and caught two passes for 14 yards in Monday night's 23-20 win over the Baltimore Ravens.
items.impact: Vidal didn't see much work for the Chargers on Monday night. He saw just two carries over the course of the night, and the team gave Omarion Hampton 22 carries, which shows their clear mindset shift away from the committee approach that they employed in the backfield for much of the season. Fantasy managers shouldn't expect Vidal to have much relevance for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Quentin Johnston quiet in win Monday
items.desc: Quentin Johnston caught one pass for just six yards in Monday night's 23-20 win over the Baltimore Ravens.
items.impact: The Chargers were able to pick up their first win of the season on Monday night, but Johnston wasn't able to get going in that game, finishing with just six yards on one catch. He isn't going to be a reliable week-to-week fantasy option moving forward, especially when Ladd McConkey (back) makes his return to the lineup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Omarion Hampton plays well in win Monday
items.desc: Omarion Hampton rushed the ball 22 times for 105 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 23-20 win over the Baltimore Ravens.
items.impact: The Chargers finally gave Hampton the bulk of the work in their backfield on Monday night, and he was able to put up over 100 yards and a touchdown on good efficiency en route to the team's first win. It seems reasonable to assume that they will continue to give him the majority of touches after he found success in this game, so fantasy managers should be looking to pick him up if he was dropped earlier in the season in their league.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Justin Herbert scores once in win Monday
items.desc: Justin Herbert completed 12-of-18 passing attempts for 129 yards and added 51 yards  and a touchdown on the ground in Monday night's 23-20 win over the Baltimore Ravens.
items.impact: The Chargers were finally able to pick up a win on Monday night, squeaking out a three-point win over the Ravens on the road. He wasn't particularly productive through the air, but he was able to add 51 yards and a touchdown on the ground, which left him with a respectable fantasy total. He isn't expected to be a fantasy option worth starting anytime soon, but it's nice to see some signs of life from him and Los Angeles' offense.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brandon Cisse (rib) not expected to miss significant time
items.desc: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said Brandon Cisse is not expected to miss significant time with rib injury.
items.impact: It is unclear if IR is being considered. Either way, the rookie will miss some time.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Johnathan Edwards signs with Colts active roster
items.desc: The Colts have signed CB Johnathan Edwards to the 53-man roster.
items.impact: Edwards had been on the Colts practice squad. He will add depth in their secondary.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Skyy Moore (ankle) avoids serious injury
items.desc: Packers WR/KR Skyy Moore's ankle injury from Sunday is not considered serious.
items.impact: Moore just returned from injured reserve due to an ankle injury. Green Bay will be cautious with him.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tavierre Thomas signed by Giants
items.desc: The Giants are signing DB Tavierre Thomas off the Vikings' practice squad.
items.impact: Thomas will add depth in the secondary for the Giants.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Marco Wilson signs with Panthers active roster
items.desc: The Panthers are signing CB Marco Wilson from their practice squad to their active roster.
items.impact: Wilson will add depth in the corner back room for Carolina.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: John Ojukwu signs with Eagles active roster
items.desc: The Eagles signed OL John Ojukwu to their active roster.
items.impact: Ojukwu will add depth on the offensive line for Philadelphia.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Will Shipley has practice window opened
items.desc: The Eagles opened the practice window of RB Will Shipley.
items.impact: Shipley will have 21 days to be officially activated.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaydon Blue signs with Eagles
items.desc: The Eagles signed RB Jaydon Blue to their practice squad.
items.impact: Blue will add depth in the backfield for Philadelphia.
